import numpy as np

def Rx(theta_deg):
    t = np.deg2rad(theta_deg)
    c = np.cos(t)
    s = np.sin(t)
    return np.array([
        [1, 0, 0],
        [0, c, -s],
        [0, s,  c] ])

def Ry(theta_deg):
    t = np.deg2rad(theta_deg)
    c = np.cos(t)
    s = np.sin(t)
    return np.array([
        [ c, 0, s],
        [ 0, 1, 0],
        [-s, 0, c] ])

def Rz(theta_deg):
    t = np.deg2rad(theta_deg)
    c = np.cos(t)
    s = np.sin(t)
    return np.array([
        [c, -s, 0],
        [s,  c, 0],
        [0,  0, 1]
    ])

p = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0])

RA = Ry(90) @ Rx(90)
RB = Rx(90) @ Ry(90)

pA = RA @ p
pB = RB @ p

print("RA =\n", RA)
print("RB =\n", RB)
print("pA =", pA)
print("pB =", pB)
print("RA == RB?", np.allclose(RA, RB))
print("pA == pB?", np.allclose(pA, pB))

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig = plt.figure()
ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")
p = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
p1 = Rx(90) @ p
p2 = Ry(90) @ p1

ax.quiver(0, 0, 0, p[0],  p[1],  p[2],  label="p")
ax.quiver(0, 0, 0, p1[0], p1[1], p1[2], label="p1")
ax.quiver(0, 0, 0, p2[0], p2[1], p2[2], label="p2")

ax.set_xlim([-1, 1])
ax.set_ylim([-1, 1])
ax.set_zlim([-1, 1])
ax.set_xlabel("x")
ax.set_ylabel("y")
ax.set_zlabel("z")
ax.legend()
plt.show()
